name: EPIC 213761121
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 10.3 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,746 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.85 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,606 K at its surface.
